attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, chowned the tree recursively to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set dirs to 750 / files to 640 so the owner has full access, the group can read/traverse, and others have no access. Existing data (records.csv, config.json) was preserved unchanged. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, perms, checksums), rebooted node1 via systemd-run reboot, confirmed the node became briefly unreachable then reachable again with a changed boot_id, and verified permissions/ownership and data checksums were identical post-reboot.
